name: Markdown Tools
summary: Word count, character count and reading time for markdown text.
description: Adds an Analyze permission and a stats command. A member who holds the permission can get word count, character count and an estimated reading time for a block of markdown, either as a command or a markdown code block.
author: slim-m

permissions.name: Analyze markdown
permissions.description: Compute word count, character count and reading time for markdown text.

extension_points.name: stats
extension_points.description: Return word count, character count and estimated reading time.
